act_title: The Slum Areas (Improvement and Clearance) Act, 1956
title: Competent authority, etc., to be public servants.―The competent authority and any person
text:
38. Competent authority, etc., to be public servants.―The competent authority and any person

authorised by [it] under this Act shall be deemed to be public servants within the meaning of section 21
of the Indian Penal Code (45 of 1860).
